messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers struggle to track changes to documents, leading to confusion about which version is current. This lack of clear versioning creates risk and inefficiency in managing claim files.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, an account with 2400000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-01-15, raised document versioning on the sales route [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n- This is the only account, mention and route recorded in the fact sheet as of 2026-11-03, so the evidence covers 1 account, 1 mention and 1 route [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- On 2026-09-15, Hollinbrook Home Insurance asked how document versioning is handled and said they have lost track of updates before [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n- The mention came through the sales route, the only route represented in the fact sheet [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n- The account has 2400000.0 GBP in ARR and 1 renewal within 90 days, dated 2027-01-15 [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n- No insight in the fact sheet points the other way; the single recorded insight is a concern about versioning, not a statement that current handling is sufficient [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n\n## Why now\n\n- The account renews on 2027-01-15, which is 1 renewal within 90 days of the fact sheet date of 2026-11-03 [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n- The versioning question was raised on the sales route on 2026-09-15, ahead of that renewal [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n- With 2400000.0 GBP in ARR attached to this account, the versioning concern sits against a live renewal window [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].\n",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "58121f2a061cdd5b",
   "quote": "Great. And how do you handle document versioning? We’ve lost track of updates before.",
   "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-09-15T14:44:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 2400000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 1,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
    "arr_gbp": 2400000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-01-15",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the ARR figure (2,400,000 GBP), renewal date (2027-01-15), account name, route (sales), mention date (2026-09-15), and the counts (1 account, 1 mention, 1 route, 1 renewal within 90 days) against the fact sheet and the cited insight [i:58121f2a061cdd5b]; all match. The paraphrased insight ('asked how document versioning is handled and said they have lost track of updates before') accurately reflects the quote without placing paraphrase in quotation marks. Scope claims ('only account, mention and route', 'no insight points the other way') are consistent with the single recorded insight, and no contrary evidence exists in the fact sheet.", "verdict": "pass"}
